title: TrucksIL vehicle profile (draft)
description: Dimensions and weights of a vehicle used for route checks. Bounds are sanity limits, not legal limits.

axleCount.description: Total number of axles of the vehicle or combination (tractor + trailer). Sent to Valhalla as truck axle_count (OSM maxaxles).

hazmat.description: Dangerous goods carried, by ADR class (1-9). adrTunnelCode is the tunnel restriction code from the ADR transport document (ADR 1.1.3.6 / 8.6.4); if omitted, the most restrictive code B is assumed (ADR-0013).

adrTunnelCode.description: ADR tunnel restriction code. Combination codes are reduced to their most restrictive (first) letter. '-' = no tunnel restriction.
